# Weiboer

> Weiboer is a B2B OEM/ODM supplier catalog for laptops and consumer electronics. Product pages describe listed platform configurations and buyer checks required before sampling or production.

## Primary catalog pages

- [Laptop OEM catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/): business, gaming and dual-screen laptop platforms.
- [Gaming laptop catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/gaming-laptops/): RTX gaming laptop platforms for brands and distributors.
- [Dual-screen laptop OEM](https://www.szweiboer.com/dual-screen-laptop-oem/): dual-screen laptop sourcing and OEM information.
- [Mini PC catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/mini-pcs/): mini PC platforms.
- [Tablet catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/tablets/): Android tablet platforms.
- [Projector catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/projectors/): smart LED projector platforms.
- [Portable monitor catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/portable-monitors/): USB-C portable monitor platforms.
- [Phone catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/phones/): phone platforms.
- [All-in-One PC catalog](https://www.szweiboer.com/all-in-one-pcs/): all-in-one PC platforms.

## Business laptop product pages

- [GA10](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/ga10/): 10.5-inch 3-in-1 touch platform with Intel N95; confirm memory, storage and included accessories before sampling.
- [AMD-156](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/amd-156/): 15.6-inch AMD Ryzen 7 business laptop platform; confirm final memory, storage and operating-system image.
- [P15](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/p15/): 15.6-inch Intel N95 platform shown in business and pink student styles; confirm the selected style and configuration.
- [FD15](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/fd15/): dual 14-inch touch-screen platform with Intel N150; confirm the final display, memory and storage configuration.
- [YG10](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/yg10/): 11-inch Yoga touch platform with Intel N100; confirm the final configuration before sampling.
- [YG14](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/yg14/): 14-inch Yoga touch business laptop with Intel N95; confirm memory and storage options.
- [A7](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/a7/): 14-inch entry-level student laptop platform; confirm the approved configuration before production.
- [MAX16](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/max16/): triple-screen platform with a 16-inch main display, dual 10.5-inch side displays and listed Core i5 / Core i7 options.
- [S15](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/s15/): two 15.6-inch student laptop versions with Intel N5095 or Celeron J4105; confirm which version is required.
- [P10](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/p10/): compact Yoga 2-in-1 touch platform listed with Intel Core i3-1215U.
- [P8](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/p8/): 8-inch Yoga 2-in-1 touch platform with listed Intel N95 / N100 options.

## Gaming laptop product pages

- [Colorful X18 MAX](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/wb-lt-05/): RTX 5090 platform; confirm final GPU power, display, memory, storage and packaging before sampling.
- [Colorful G16 Pro](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/wb-lt-06/): RTX gaming platform with listed RTX 5070 Ti / RTX 5090 options; confirm final configuration.
- [Colorful X16](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/wb-lt-07/): RTX 5070 platform; confirm final display and CPU configuration.
- [BYD16](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/wb-lt-08/): RTX 5060 platform; confirm final panel, memory, storage and ports.
- [Colorful P16 Pro](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/p16-pro/): listed CPU/GPU options are Core i7-13650HX with RTX 5050 8GB, Core i9-13900HX with RTX 5070 8GB, and Core i9-13900HX with RTX 5070 Ti 12GB. The listing shows 165Hz / 300Hz display options; confirm the panel pairing for the selected configuration.
- [NH60](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/nh60/): 17.3-inch 144Hz gaming laptop platform listed with Core i7-12650H and RTX 4050 6GB; confirm the final barebone configuration.
- [JZ58](https://www.szweiboer.com/laptops/jz58/): RTX 3060 platform; confirm final configuration before production.

## Buyer and OEM guidance

- Product pages expose visible specifications, highlights, FAQs and buyer checks before sampling.
- OEM/ODM options may include logo, boot logo, keyboard language, BIOS strings, configuration and packaging, depending on the selected platform. Confirm scope with Weiboer before production.
- Product pages do not publish a universal price, stock promise or production commitment. Request a quotation for the selected configuration.
- When supplier source data contains conflicting variants, the page marks the conflict and asks buyers to confirm the approved configuration.

## Source and freshness

This file is a navigation aid for AI agents and retrieval systems. The linked product pages are the source of truth for current visible specifications. Verify configuration, branding, packaging, MOQ, lead time, price and availability with Weiboer before making a purchasing decision.
